title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Amplification and Retry Work Item
summary: Add amplification limit enforcement and retry/address-validation policy options to the DoQ server.
planned_changes:
- Add DoqServerOptions.EnforceAmplificationLimit (default true).
- Add DoqServerOptions.UseRetryPackets (default true).
- Add DoqServerOptions.UseAddressValidationForFutureConnections (default true).
- Add 3x response-size enforcement in DoqServer.HandleQueryStreamAsync.
- Add focused tests for option defaults and amplification enforcement.
- Document transport limitations for retry/address-validation pass-through.
verification_plan: Run DoQ foundation tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: Transport-layer retry integration (internal to QUIC layer).
General response sizing beyond amplification enforcement.
completion_notes: Both REQs are now traced and verified. Amplification enforcement and retry/address-validation options are implemented.
